nodes.name: vision.py
nodes.summary: Vision-language support for MLX engines: loads vision processors and projectors, builds VLM prompts, finds and encodes image regions, and runs sync/async multi-device vision pipeline passes for image models.

nodes.name: _run_processor
nodes.summary: Runs an image processor on a batch of images and converts torch tensors to MLX arrays.

nodes.name: _instantiate_projector
nodes.summary: Instantiates the vision projector module from model weights.

nodes.name: _patch_video_processor
nodes.summary: Applies compatibility patches to video processors for MLX VLM models.

nodes.name: _format_vlm_messages
nodes.summary: Formats chat messages into the message format expected by MLX VLM prompt utilities.

nodes.name: build_vision_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the final prompt string for vision-language tasks from messages and image media.

nodes.name: get_inner_model
nodes.summary: Unwraps the inner transformer model from a wrapped vision model.

nodes.name: create_vision_embeddings
nodes.summary: Computes vision embeddings for image regions and scatters them into the text embedding sequence.

nodes.name: _find_media_regions
nodes.summary: Locates base64 image regions in the token stream and hashes them for caching.

nodes.name: prepare_vision
nodes.summary: Top-level preparation hook: builds the vision prompt, encodes images, and returns processed inputs for the engine.

nodes.name: MediaRegion
nodes.summary: Describes a base64 image region found within a token stream.

nodes.name: VisionResult
nodes.summary: Container for vision processing output: prompt text and image embeddings.

nodes.name: VisionEncoder
nodes.summary: Loads vision processor/projector weights, encodes images into embeddings, and caches image features.

nodes.name: VisionProcessor
nodes.summary: Orchestrates vision prompt building, image encoding, and media-region detection for a generation task.

nodes.name: bootstrap.py
nodes.summary: Runner process bootstrap entrypoint: raises file-descriptor limits, sets MLX fast-synch flags, constructs the image or MLX engine builder, and runs the Runner main loop while reporting termination errors back through the event channel.

nodes.name: entrypoint
nodes.summary: Entrypoint for a worker runner process: configures runtime limits, builds the appropriate engine, and runs the runner loop until termination.

nodes.name: RunnerTerminationError
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass capturing exception type, message, repr, and traceback when a runner terminates abnormally.

nodes.name: batch_generator.py
nodes.summary: Engine orchestration for LLM inference: sequential and batched generators that run MLX generation, apply chat templates and output parsers, emit SSE chunks, coordinate tasks across devices, and serve disaggregated prefill.

nodes.name: _check_for_debug_prompts
nodes.summary: Scans prompts for debug triggers that force runner failure, OOM, or timeout for testing.

nodes.name: GeneratorQueue
nodes.summary: FIFO queue generator yielding pending items or None when empty.

nodes.name: SequentialGenerator
nodes.summary: Engine implementing single-request sequential token generation with warmup, prefill progress, and chunk streaming.

nodes.name: BatchGenerator
nodes.summary: Engine for batched multi-request generation: agrees on tasks across devices, applies chat templates and output parsers, streams SSE chunks, and serves disaggregated prefill requests.

nodes.name: model_output_parsers.py
nodes.summary: Streams model generation responses through model-specific parsers (GPT-OSS, DeepSeek V3.2/V4, thinking models, generic tool calls) converting raw GenerationResponses into GenerationChunks with finish reasoning and token accounting.

nodes.name: count_reasoning_tokens
nodes.summary: Counts thinking tokens and patches reasoning-token usage into the final response.

nodes.name: apply_all_parsers
nodes.summary: Chains the correct parser pipeline for a model type and maps responses into GenerationChunks.

nodes.name: map_responses_to_chunks
nodes.summary: Converts a runner response into the corresponding GenerationChunk subtype.

nodes.name: parse_gpt_oss
nodes.summary: Parses GPT-OSS model output into text and tool-call chunks using a Harmony streamable parser.

nodes.name: parse_deepseek_v32
nodes.summary: Parses DeepSeek V3.2 streaming output with thinking markers.

nodes.name: parse_deepseek_v4
nodes.summary: Parses DeepSeek V4 streaming output with thinking markers.

nodes.name: _parse_dsml_stream
nodes.summary: State machine parsing DeepSeek-MLX marker streams, buffering partial marker prefixes.

nodes.name: _could_be_marker_prefix
nodes.summary: Checks whether buffered text could be the start of a marker token.

nodes.name: parse_thinking_models
nodes.summary: Parses thinking-model output, splitting reasoning and answer spans and draining buffered thinking text.

nodes.name: parse_tool_calls
nodes.summary: Parses generic tool calls from assistant output using the configured tool parser.

nodes.name: tool_parsers.py
nodes.summary: Tool-call parsing helpers that detect JSON/MLX tool-call formats and coerce parsed arguments against JSON schemas for OpenAI-compatible tool use.

nodes.name: _json_type_matches
nodes.summary: Checks whether a value matches an expected JSON schema type.

nodes.name: _coerce_tool_arg_with_schema
nodes.summary: Coerces a single tool-call argument to match its JSON schema type.

nodes.name: _coerce_tool_calls_to_schema
nodes.summary: Coerces all tool-call arguments to conform to the provided tool schemas.

nodes.name: make_mlx_parser
nodes.summary: Builds a tool parser for MLX models' tool-call output format.

nodes.name: _parse_json_calls
nodes.summary: Parses raw JSON tool-call output into ToolCallItem objects.

nodes.name: _flatten
nodes.summary: Flattens nested JSON tool-call structures.

nodes.name: make_json_parser
nodes.summary: Builds a tool parser for generic JSON tool-call output.

nodes.name: infer_tool_parser
nodes.summary: Selects the appropriate tool parser based on the model type.

nodes.name: ToolParser
nodes.summary: Dataclass wrapping a start/end parsing delimiter and inner parser, with schema coercion for tool calls.
